programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs y el equipo investigan cuando el libro de Mcgee sobre un agente de la NCIS se convierte en realidad. McGee se horroriza cuando un contramaestre en el que basó al personaje de su libro es asesinado.

programme.desc: Después de que una mujer es asesinada en su apartamento, Danny y Báez recurren a su hija, Margo, para pedir ayuda, pero en cambio ella complica la investigación.

programme.title: Blue Bloods (en español)
programme.desc: El amigo de Frank, Lenny, le revela que un próximo artículo revelador expondrá algo de la ropa sucia del NYPD. Erin debe decidir cómo cargar a un médico cuyos tratamientos experimentales llevaron a la muerte de su hija.

programme.title: Blue Bloods (en español)
programme.desc: Después de un incidente en el que los refuerzos del oficial Witten no pudieron mantenerse físicamente a la par de una persecución, Frank debe decidir si implementar una prueba de aptitud más rigurosa para el NYPD.

programme.title: Blue Bloods (en español)
programme.desc: Después de que alguien irrumpa en la casa de Luis Delgado y mate a su esposa, Luis y Danny se unen para atrapar al malvado asesino, quien también puede ser responsable de la muerte de Linda.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Después de un asesino en serie es ejecutado en Oklahoma, un imitador aparece y los agentes del FBI son llamados para encontrarlo. Al mismo tiempo, Prentiss se pone nerviosa pensando en una importante compra inmobiliaria.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: La UAC presenta uno de los casos más longevos de un asesino en serie a unos estudiantes universitarios, y llevan la clase a través de los 20 años en los que persiguieron al asesino.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Cuando una banda de ladrones de bancos inicia su último robo en un banco de Washington D.C., la UAC intenta negociar los rehenes con los ladrones, pero las apuestas comienzan a elevarse cuando uno de los suyos se convierte en rehén.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Mientras la UAC continua persiguiendo a los ladrones, el equipo determina que los sospechosos tienen un objetivo más grande en D.C., y con uno del equipo como rehén, tienen que trabajar rápidamente para desactivar una situación explosiva.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: La Directora Shepard toma un riesgo absoluto al encontrarse a solas con un informante que tenía información sobre Le Grenouille, pero en encuentro sale mal y el contacto es asesinado.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs y el equipo investigan el asesinato de un contramaestre que aparece inadvertidamente en una fotografía tomada de forma casual por un fotógrafo ciego.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs ignora el pepeleo burocrático asociado a su posición como director activo y lidera la investigación del una víctima de asesinato encontrada en un taxi que se dirigía al cuartel general de NCIS.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Pistas de Elefante

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un asesino en serie andaba suelto y la policía tenía que encontrarlo antes de que atacara nuevamente. Su pista más prometedora era inusual: una huella dactilar sangrienta en el cuerpo de una de las víctimas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Intrusión bienvenida

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Evidencia del Jefe

programme.title: Tower Heist
programme.desc: Chaos fills this comedy starring Eddie Murphy and Ben Stiller. When a group of employees discovers that they are victims of their boss's Ponzi scheme, they decide to rob him.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final...
programme.desc: 'Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning'. The spy escapades of Ethan Hunt and the IMF come to an end. They must stop a rogue AI called 'The Entity' before it destroys the world.

programme.title: Girls Trip
programme.desc: The party heads to New Orleans for an ensemble cast in this acclaimed comedy. On a wild reunion trip, four lifelong friends find romance, sisterhood and absolute chaos.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthy gives a savage act in this riotous comedy. A titan of the industry goes to prison for insider trading. On her release, she tries to mend the bridges she burnt.

programme.title: After Ever Happy
programme.desc: The fourth film of the 'After' franchise. A shocking truth about the couple's families emerges, leading Tessa and Hardin to realise they aren't as different from each other.

programme.title: Kingdoms Of Fire, Ice & Fairytales
programme.desc: Get up close and personal with the ice-covered landmass of Antarctica, the magical Black Forest of Germany, and the iconic Yellowstone of the USA, get up close and personal to these three world wonders.

programme.title: The Dilemma
programme.desc: Vince Vaughn is caught in a dilemma of epic proportions in this comedy about morals and friendship. A man discovers that his best friend's wife is having an affair.

programme.title: Skemerson
programme.desc: A young man battling mental illness decides to kill himself by jumping off the Bloukrans Bridge. On the bridge, he meets someone who sets his life on a completely different path.

programme.title: The Honeymooners
programme.desc: Cedric The Entertainer and Mike Epps are a hilarious comedic duo in this tale of a dreamer and his sidekick, who run into trouble after investing in a money-making scheme.

programme.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
programme.desc: Evil returns in this visually stunning sequel to the edgy adaptation of Snow White. Chris Hemsworth battles two sinister sisters: Charlize Theron and Emily Blunt.

programme.title: The Tale Of Despereaux
programme.desc: It's been called the cinematic equivalent of a bedtime story - and this tale of a brave little mouse and his band of unlikely heroes is as lovingly told.

programme.title: Upon The Magic Roads
programme.desc: An epic live-action fairy tale fantasy. Foal and his friend John go on an adventure where they will have to outsmart a tyrant king, catch the firebird, and find John's true love.

programme.title: Clifford The Big Red Dog
programme.desc: An amazing canine family adventure. A young girl's love for a tiny puppy named Clifford makes the dog grow to an enormous size.

programme.title: The Bad Guys
programme.desc: Sam Rockwell lends his voice to this thrilling heist animation. Several reformed yet misunderstood criminal animals attempt to become good, with disastrous results.

programme.title: Fall
programme.desc: A nail-biting survival thriller. After climbing an abandoned 2000-foot radio tower, best friends Becky and Hunter find themselves trapped at the top with no way down.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: A wedding gets turned on its head in this outrageously funny comedy. A rivalry between a maid of honour and a bridesmaid for the bride's affection leads to all sorts of chaos.

programme.title: Black Site
programme.desc: A deadly cat-and-mouse game propels this action thriller. A group of top-secret military black site officers must fight to survive when a murderous detainee escapes.

programme.title: Schindler's List
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg and Liam Neeson create a poignant and powerful film. After witnessing his Jewish workers' persecution by the Nazis, a German businessman decides to help them.

programme.title: Midway
programme.desc: Woody Harrelson, Patrick Wilson and Luke Evans star in this real-event-based WWII drama about the Battle of Midway, which was a clash between US and Japanese militaries.

programme.title: The Wish Of Fairy Fish
programme.desc: An adventure-filled fairy tale fantasy. If you go fishing, be prepared to draw the fish of your dreams, the magical Pike, which can grant any three wishes.

programme.title: The Day We Didn't Meet
programme.desc: A great South African film. Alex and Sam reconnect after a chance encounter. They imagine a fantasy life together and abandon all their responsibilities. However, reality sets in.

programme.title: Admission
programme.desc: Cute romantic comedy with funny woman Tina Fey (30 Rock). A Princeton admissions officer has a tough choice to make when she meets an applicant who could be the son she gave up for adoption.

programme.title: Golda
programme.desc: Helen Mirren drives this tense and absorbing biopic that focuses on the high-stakes decisions that Golda Meir, known as the 'Iron Lady of Israel,' faced during the Yom Kippur War.

programme.title: The Secret Kingdom
programme.desc: A thrilling fantasy adventure. At their new home, Peter and his sister are drawn into an underground kingdom, where Peter is declared the king and must save the realm from evil.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse Of The...
programme.desc: 'Wallace & Gromit: The Curse Of The Were-Rabbit'. This animation follows Wallace and Gromit, who set out to uncover the mystery behind the garden sabotage in their village.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: Halle Berry and Patrick Wilson go on a mission to save Earth. A NASA executive teams up with a former astronaut and a conspiracy theorist to stop the moon from crashing into the planet.

programme.title: Infinite
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg and Chiwetel Ejiofor drive this book-inspired sci-fi action adaptation about a man who learns he's been reincarnated many times and holds the key to saving the world.

programme.title: Jurassic World Dominion
programme.desc: The epic conclusion to the Jurassic era, where two generations unite for the first time. Dinosaurs now live and hunt alongside humans, but this fragile balance might not last.

programme.title: Medieval
programme.desc: Starring Ben Foster and Michael Caine, this is an epic take on the true story of Jan ika, one of Czech history's greatest warriors, who is said to have never lost a battle.

programme.title: The Great Wall
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Yimou Zhang helms this historical fantasy starring Matt Damon. An elite force of warriors must save humanity from a horde of monstrous creatures.

programme.title: Wrong Place
programme.desc: Bruce Willis finds himself as the prey in this action thriller. A former police chief is hunted down to prevent him from delivering eyewitness testimony against a drug family.

programme.title: Black Demon
programme.desc: An edge-of-your-seat thrilling sci-fi. An idyllic family vacation becomes a nightmare when they get stranded on a crumbling rig in Baja and encounter a vengeful megalodon shark.

programme.title: Indemnity
programme.desc: A gritty action-thriller. An ex-Cape Town fireman's world wakes up next to his wife's dead body with no recollection of what transpired and all evidence pointing to him.

programme.title: Emily
programme.desc: This biopic imagines Emily Bront's story, which inspired her book Wuthering Heights. While navigating the struggles of family life, she yearns for artistic and personal freedom.

programme.title: Knives Out
programme.desc: This book-inspired murder mystery boasts an all-star cast led by Daniel Craig. When a famous crime writer is found dead, a seasoned detective is enlisted to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Monolith
programme.desc: A gripping conspiracy thriller. When a disgraced journalist turns to podcasting to salvage her career, she uncovers a strange conspiracy theory.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: A fun animated film based on a classic newspaper comic strip. A legendary dog trainer tries to train an undisciplined dog in a bid to turn him into a World Dog Championship contender.

programme.title: King Kong
programme.desc: In this colossal action drama from director Peter Jackson, a film crew heads to a remote island to shoot a movie but encounters a legendary beast that could spell their end.

programme.title: Monster Trucks
programme.desc: Trucks and monsters come together to create a non-stop action adventure. A teenager forms a bond with a creature that's being hunted by an evil oil company and fights to save it.

programme.title: Monster Family 2
programme.desc: The crew of monsters return for another supernatural animation-the Wishbone family band together to free Baba Yaga and Renfield from Monster Hunter Mila Starr's clutches.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Pets
programme.desc: When their owners are away, the pets play in this star-studded animation. Follow the life of a terrier whose jealousy of his new roommate leads them on a wild adventure.

programme.title: Down So Long
programme.desc: Joseph Mabena lives with his family in an overcrowded house in Hangberg. When he gets injured at his workplace, Mabena receives a large compensation payment.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge Of Reason
programme.desc: This sequel to the sweet rom-com classic sees Bridget Jones finally in a stable relationship with Mark Darcy. But doubts brew when her ex-lover, Daniel Cleaver, returns.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Tom Cruise messes with forces unknown in this reboot. While trying to steal artefacts in the Middle East, a soldier accidentally awakens an ancient, malevolent princess.

programme.title: Expend4bles
programme.desc: In this guns-blazing fourth instalment of the action-packed franchise, Sylvester Stallone and Jason Statham return with new recruits to face off against an arms dealer.

programme.title: Blood Conscious
programme.desc: A horrifying thriller. A vacationing family turns the tables on a mass shooter who claims to be fighting demonic forces.

programme.title: It's Complicated
programme.desc: Meryl Streep, Steve Martin and Alec Baldwin star in this rom-com about a love triangle that sees a divorced woman have an affair with her ex-husband while dating another man.

programme.title: Snakehead
programme.desc: A high-octane action movie. A Chinese immigrant gets caught up in an international crime ring of human smuggling while attempting to make a better life for her family.

programme.title: Home Affairs: A Love Story
programme.desc: A Valentine's Day sequel to Home Affairs: A Christmas Story. The Williams family gathers to celebrate Pieter and Benita's wedding. But secrets surface, threatening their happiness.

programme.title: 47 Ronin
programme.desc: East meets West in this epic Asian fantasy film. Matrix star Keanu Reeves leads a group of 47 warriors into battle against deadly mystical forces.

programme.title: The Matrix
programme.desc: A genre-defining special effects feast. Keanu Reeves stars as Neo in this sci-fi epic about people imprisoned in a fabricated system called The Matrix.

programme.title: Sinbad: Legend Of The Seven Seas
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Catherine Zeta-Jones star in this animation. The legendary Sinbad embarks on a dangerous journey. He must clear his name after being framed by the goddess Eris.

programme.title: Rise Of The Guardians
programme.desc: Santa Claus, Jack Frost, the Easter Bunny, and the Sandman are heroes in this fantastic animated adventure. When an evil spirit threatens the world, these guardians must save the day.

programme.title: The Ant Bully
programme.desc: A fun and colourful animated adventure with the voices of Julia Roberts and Nicholas Cage. A ten-year-old boy is shrunk down to the size of an ant after he floods a colony.

programme.title: Frank & Fearless
